scope: Execution scheduling only; no scientific protocol or accepted pipeline amendment
reason: After warm-up query buffers were released, two active organization jobs left about 2294 MiB available RAM; a third independent CPU job was feasible
supervisor: Allow the queued supervisor to complete Org1-Org4, then stop its redundant Org5 job after all four completed component exit events; the separate Org5 run supplies that component
verification: A final component-aware gate must verify all five full TRAIN/VAL inventories, checkpoints, source/config hashes, exact repeats and artifact manifests before reporting PASS
data_and_model_policy: The same frozen local_training_v1 configuration, accepted sampler, split/grid/unit and 1% FPR protocol apply to every component. No weights are combined.
